pcs.pc_description: park the power tiller on a level ground
place the power tiller engine in the horizontal position for checks
check that all the operating controls such as ropes, cables, rods are positioned correctly
inspect all the nuts and bolts such as axle bolts, tyre bolts, wheel hub nuts are secured tightly
examine under and around the power tiller for any kind of fluid leakage
check various fluids such as engine oil, gearbox oil, air-cleaner oil, coolant and fuel for the prescribed levels
adjust the fan and transmission belt tension to the required level
adjust clutch, brake and side clutch as per the operator's manual
check if the tines, forks, blades and knives are attached firmly to the power tiller
inspect that all the safety guards are firmly placed
apply the recommended grade of grease/ lubricant on all moving parts, joints of levers, rear-wheel shaft and tension pulley
examine the exhaust for any wear and tear or damage
check the oil pressure indicator for the required level of oil pressure
inspect the power tiller for any abnormal sound and vibration
check the tyres for the recommended air pressure
replace the worn out or damaged guard/ any other component as per the operator's manual
maintain a detailed record of the daily check
arrange for the power tiller to be examined by the manufacturer for issues beyond own purview
arrange the relevant Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as gloves, shoes, goggles, helmet, ear-protectors for the operation
check the PPE to ensure it is safe for use
replace any faulty/ damaged PPE with the new one
arrange any additional attachments and tools as per the requirement

modules.module_title: Prepare the field for power tiller operations

pcs.pc_description: inspect the field to ensure that it is free of potentially hazardous obstacles such as glass, large stones, wires, etc.
check the wetness of the soil to determine its suitability for the movement of power tiller
carry out weeding of any long vegetation from the field
remove all debris and waste material from the field to allow for smooth movement of power tiller
perform a soil test to assess the need for any kind of soil treatment
apply the necessary treatment such as lime, fertilizer, sulphur before tilling to allow it to integrate into the soil during tilling
ensure that there is nobody on the field without any reason

modules.module_title: Operate power tiller to carry out field operations

pcs.pc_description: place the power tiller on a flat ground
connect the required attachment to the power tiller
remove any debris from the power tiller tines
pull the tine clutch lever forward until it locks into place to disengage the tines
start the power tiller as per the SOP
operate the power tiller at a speed suitable to its capability and the field conditions
break the soil as per the requirement
carry out tilling to the optimal depth recommended for the proposed crop
raise the tines for shallower tilling when the engine Revolutions Per Minute (RPM) decreases or stalls due to overloading
carry out cross-tilling as per the requirement on extra hard and dry soil
carry out tilling in a pattern to achieve machine efficiency
apply seed in the field at the recommended speed by attaching a seed spreader to the power tiller
use the relevant PPE while carrying out field operations

modules.module_title: Carry out puddling by attaching cage wheels

pcs.pc_description: remove the power tiller tyres as per the operator’s manual
attach lugged wheels or drum type cage wheels to power tiller according to the soil conditions
attach curved tynes to the rotary
attach the tail wheel float to control the depth of digging
determine the availability of the required level of water in the field for puddling
carry out puddling to achieve the required puddle and field levelling

modules.module_title: Cultivate the field by attaching cultivator

pcs.pc_description: hitch cultivator to the power tiller as per the SOP
adjust the cultivator to achieve the required level of cultivation depth for placing seeds
operate cultivator as per the SOP
check the cultivator regularly during operation for clogging

modules.module_title: Apply seeds and fertilizer by attaching seed-cum- fertilizer drill

pcs.pc_description: attach seed-cum-fertilizer drill to power tiller as per the SOP
adjust the drill as per the requirement
fill in seeds and fertilizer in the seed and fertilizer boxes to the desired level
apply seeds and fertilizer in the field at the recommended speed

modules.module_title: Reap the crop by attaching reaper

pcs.pc_description: examine the reaper knives for sharpness
connect reaper with the power tiller as per the SOP
apply necessary adjustments to reaper as per the requirements
operate reaper at a speed suitable to crop and farm conditions
check the reaper regularly for clogging during operation

modules.module_title: Spray insecticides and pesticides by attaching boom sprayer

pcs.pc_description: inspect the spray boom, mast, spray pump, pressure regulator and chemical tank for any wear and tear or damage
mount the boom sprayer on the power tiller as per the SOP
hitch the tail wheel frame to the power tiller
check the boom sprayer is secured firmly
adjust the spacing between the spraying nozzles
operate the boom sprayer as per the operator's manual to spray insecticides and pesticides

modules.module_title: Slash and shred the crop by attaching slasher cum in-situ shredder

pcs.pc_description: mount slasher cum in-situ shredder on the power tiller chassis frame as per the SOP
install a v-belt to transmit power tiller's engine power to slasher cum in-situ shredder
check the v-belt for the prescribed level of tension
install cutting blades on the curved rotary header in slashing assembly
operate slasher cum in-situ shredder as per the operator's manual
use protection hood while shredding to ensure own safety and prevent the shredded crop from scattering

modules.module_title: Pump water by attaching a water pump

pcs.pc_description: set up the water pump on a pump stand at the identified spot
connect the water pump with the power tiller
install a v-belt to allow transmission of power from the power tiller to the water pump
inspect the v-belt for the correct level of tension
start the power tiller to pump water
pump water using power tiller for the recommended duration

pcs.pc_description: arrange the appropriate tools, equipment and spare parts for repair and maintenance activities
examine all the nuts and bolts for the recommended torque and locking
inspect the tyres for the recommended air pressure and any wear and tear/ damage
inspect the power tiller’s electrical system for the correct functioning
check the oil pressure indicator for the recommended oil pressure
clean the power tiller as per the operator’s manual
apply the recommended grade of grease/ lubricant on all the greasing points such as main clutch thrust bearing, intermediate bearing, clutch lever, rotavator shaft, arm shafts and shift fork, etc.
clean the crankcase and oil screen assembly as per the SOP
adjust accelerator, brake, clutch, v-belt, fan- belt, etc. as per the operator’s manual
set the injector pressure to the recommended level
replace the engine oil, gear case oil, coolant etc. as per the maintenance schedule
replace the worn-out filters such as oil filter/ air cleaner filter/ fuel filter
install new and compatible rotavator blades and tyres to replace the ones worn-out or damaged
maintain the record of maintenance
schedule the next maintenance as per the maintenance schedule

modules.module_title: Comply with the health and safety standards

pcs.pc_description: use the recommended PPE and clothing while carrying out repair and maintenance activities
apply the relevant health and safety standards to deal with any emergencies/ accidents
replace the worn-out/ damaged PPE and clothing
report any hazards/ accidents to the relevant authority in a timely manner
segregate waste into different categories
dispose non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit recyclable and reusable material at the identified location
optimise usage of various material in different tasks/ activities/ processes
optimise usage of water/ electricity/ energy in various tasks/ activities/ processes
connect electrical tools and equipment safely and turn off when not in use
